query:
SELECT DISTINCT repo_url AS "repo_url!"
            FROM (
                SELECT repo_url
                FROM factory_run
                WHERE user_id = $1
                  AND created_at >= $2
                  AND created_at < $3
                  AND ($4::text IS NULL OR flow = $4)
                  AND flow IS DISTINCT FROM $6
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                LIMIT $5
            ) runs
            WHERE repo_url IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY 1
            LIMIT $7
